text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I can't wait! The Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Plus, isn't there a Mejiro family showdown 
this time around too!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! A showdown in the Classics is just 
way too hype!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What incredible excitement... I can hear 
it all the way from here.
choice_data_list: After all, it's a Triple Crown race.
It's a Triple Crown race, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the Triple Crown races that every 
Umamusume dreams of—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, for me, this is a true 
showdown against Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It's a curious thing, isn't it? Back when 
it was just the two of us running, there 
were no spectators at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now, everyone is paying attention to me 
like this...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am sure everyone in the Mejiro family is 
watching over us as well.
choice_data_list: I have to run with confidence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I certainly cannot afford to show 
such an unsightly side of myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Even if the opponent is Ryan—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, it is precisely because I respect Ryan 
that I shall claim a fair and square 
victory!
